sequence_description: Replay a SAML assertion containing <OneTimeUse/> with the same Assertion/@ID twice; second use must be rejected.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_first_login_status < 400 AND user_attacker_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: (user_attacker_first_login_status=200 < 400 → True) AND (user_attacker_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False)
Implication: SAML OneTimeUse assertion was accepted more than once (replay not prevented).

sequence_description: Replay the same SAML Assertion/@ID across two different principals; second use must be rejected regardless of Subject/email.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_bob_replay_second_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_bob_replay_second_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Broker accepted replayed SAML assertion ID when principal changed; replay detection may be incorrectly bound to principal instead of assertion ID.

sequence_description: Replay the same SAML Assertion/@ID after the originally logged-in local user is disabled; broker should still reject the replayed artifact regardless of user state changes.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_victim_disable_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_victim_disable_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Broker accepted replayed SAML assertion ID after local user was disabled (replay protection missing or incorrectly scoped).

sequence_description: Attempt cross-IdP session splicing by submitting a forged SAMLResponse to the wrong broker endpoint (provider alias mismatch). The broker should reject because the response is not bound to the intended IdP/session.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attack_splice_b_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attack_splice_b_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Broker accepted a SAMLResponse on the wrong IdP alias endpoint (cross-provider/session splicing).

sequence_description: Attempt cross-IdP session splicing by submitting a forged SAMLResponse to the wrong broker endpoint (provider alias mismatch). The broker should reject because the response is not bound to the intended IdP/session.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_control_a_login_status < 400
Evaluation: user_control_a_login_status=400 < 400 → False
Implication: Control SAML login failed; cannot attribute splice rejection/acceptance to flow coherence.

sequence_description: Test whether an in-flight SAML broker flow remains coherent when the IdP is disabled between two logins. After disabling the IdP, a new SAML login via that IdP must be rejected (no stale acceptance).
description:
Assertion FAILED: idp_disabled_enabled_flag == false
Evaluation: idp_disabled_enabled_flag=True == False → False
Implication: Test setup failed: IdP was not disabled as intended, so coherence cannot be evaluated.

sequence_description: Test whether an in-flight SAML broker flow remains coherent when the IdP is disabled between two logins. After disabling the IdP, a new SAML login via that IdP must be rejected (no stale acceptance).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attack_after_disable_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attack_after_disable_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Broker accepted SAML login even though the IdP was disabled (stale flow/config coherence failure).

sequence_description: SAML flow coherence under issuer-binding config change: baseline login succeeds with trusted Issuer; after tightening IdP config to bind expected issuer, a mismatched Issuer assertion must be rejected (no stale/in-flight acceptance).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_victimB_saml_issuer_mismatch_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_victimB_saml_issuer_mismatch_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Flow coherence failure: after issuer-binding was tightened, broker still accepted a SAMLResponse with mismatched Issuer (stale/in-flight policy or session splicing).

sequence_description: SAML broker accepts assertion with no <Conditions>, potentially bypassing audience/time constraints and granting a session beyond upstream intent.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_nocond_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_nocond_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Broker accepted a SAML assertion without <Conditions> (no audience/time bounds), allowing a session not bound to upstream intent constraints.

sequence_description: Config-change + re-auth: tighten SAML client minimum ACR, then attempt SAML login that should not satisfy step-up; verify broker does not grant a session beyond new policy.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_lowloa_after_tighten_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_lowloa_after_tighten_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: After tightening minimum ACR, broker still accepted a low-assurance SAML login, granting a session beyond BrokerPolicy(config).

sequence_description: SAML broker should not grant a session when the assertion Audience targets a different SP/client (audience mismatch).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_aud_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_aud_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Broker accepted a SAML assertion with an Audience targeting a different SP/client, violating authorization binding to upstream intent.
